title: hive bot structured log line (v3)
description: One JSON-line event emitted by Hive::Bot::Logger. v3 adds a required `level` field to every log line plus an optional `category` tag (present only on events that carry one, e.g. noise; omitted otherwise), and adds `poll_unhealthy` for loud poll-health escalation. v2 is kept as-is for historical log lines. Like prior versions, v3 follows additive-only evolution: new enum values may be appended to `event` without a SCHEMA_VERSION bump. Breaking changes (removing or renaming an event, changing the value shape of an existing event, or removing required fields) require a v4 schema file with $id and `schema_version` bumped.

category.description: Optional open-set tag. The only convention-bearing value is "noise", marking high-frequency, low-signal lines (benign poll-transport failures, dedupe/backoff skips). Nothing in the producer gem filters on it — it is a downstream-only contract for a log viewer or forwarder to drop category=noise lines.
